title: Building in the AI Industry, or with AI, in Africa

c930ab38c592.text: “The future belongs to those who don’t wait for permission to create.”

719440bf54c0.text: There’s a lot of talk about artificial intelligence — mostly about
it. Me included, haha. But there’s still far too little talk about
: building in the AI industry, or with AI as a tool, especially in Africa.

fd4bc26480dc.text: In the DRC, as elsewhere on the continent, tech innovation is moving forward, but slowly. While others are designing the AIs, here we too often settle for using them rather than creating. According to the

5864a66c84a2.text: , available to anyone bold enough to use them. And above all:
there’s still everything left to invent

5d42f4eb2258.text: In this article, I’m sharing a little guide to creating with AI or in AI, from right here, with our own means, our own needs and our own vision.

0ed6fb8410a7.text: NB: This article is simply an invitation to create, born from my observations, my experiments… and a few very stubborn lines of code.

9b6377d2bbb9.text: #1. Building in the AI industry — without being a machine learning researcher

8433e0e32744.text: One of the biggest misconceptions about AI is believing you have to be a math researcher, master deep learning or train your own model from scratch to "be part of the industry". That’s just not true.

ca9604006c7e.text: the AI ecosystem is broad, open and increasingly modular
build in AI without building the AI itself

f3fb542b0cc1.text: Develop a mobile app that integrates summarization, translation or content generation features through APIs (like OpenAI, Cohere or Mistral).

e73e4c5a4c22.text: Design a smart chatbot to guide museum visitors or a brand’s customers.

69e8f47994fa.text: Offer an educational platform that personalizes learning using simple recommendation models.

7dfa1c97a5ad.text: The people who will succeed in this industry are the ones who understand
how to piece together existing AI building blocks

4dc8bf9ee532.text: AI: amplifying your creativity, not replacing it

568946117061.text: Creating with AI is like working with an assistant that never sleeps, always available, always fast… but that does nothing relevant without your vision.

f2513a432d6f.text: It speeds things up, it suggests, it organizes. But the direction, the style, the human touch: that’s you and me.

ede1931b67c4.text: How I use AI day to day

ca957ff5e63b.text: No fuss, here are a few concrete uses I’ve tested — and that I recommend:

5e74afd77e9d.text: to draft article outlines based on my own clear core ideas, rephrase, generate repetitive code, brainstorm.

6dfbaf0483d6.text: to create visuals (images and video) that illustrate ideas and contexts.

3c8f2a4af168.text: to summarize, sort, plan, or even tidy up my personal notes.

9fbe1e6f59c4.text: to automatically transcribe interviews or meetings.

180d759ac869.text: So creating with AI is above all about
, a hybrid language between human intuition and algorithmic power.

08fa340d5dc1.text: Creating with AI doesn’t start with technology. It starts with
. Looking around you, understanding real needs, spotting everyday friction points.

a37f3e55001b.text: In Africa, there’s no shortage of opportunities. What’s sometimes missing is the reflex to ask yourself:
"what if I could solve this with a smart tool?"

c90aeb179774.text: Here are three questions to frame an idea:

a8fa8fd3b415.text: What need or roadblock keeps coming up in my environment?

99553951cfe3.text: Can AI automate, speed up or personalize part of that process?

bec2e88e3a86.text: Can I prototype it quickly with an API or a no-code platform?

2c8f75a66239.text: An app that automatically adapts educational content to the user’s level and cultural context.

3728bc35e390.text: A decision-support AI for small businesses, or a specialized chatbot built for an institution and its audience

2654f3e2c1c9.text: #4 Building your own AI model? Not always necessary

ad625612b266.text: The temptation to train your own model is understandable. But let’s stay clear-eyed:
it’s not an essential step to innovate with AI

bc76f12a0b95.text: quality datasets, often missing or scattered in our contexts,

19c510f08f16.text: not to use what already exists.

1f5fed14b891.text: In my opinion, building a custom AI model can make sense if:

49c219ed4c14.text: the field relies on a very specific language or cultural context (African languages, local legal corpora, community health…).

c9325335aa05.text: control over the data is strategic (public sector, education, security…).

2f597bb5e40e.text: it’s essential to shape an agent or a system with its own identity, with logic firmly rooted in the realities on the ground.

f801941c2504.text: In the vast majority of cases,
the available models (GPT, Claude, Mistral, etc.) are powerful enough
to prototype, test and ship relevant solutions.

df58e5dfe443.text: It’s not about proving your technical chops, it’s about bringing value where it’s lacking.

e0f8c85ec9d7.text: Building in the AI industry or with AI isn’t a luxury. It’s a necessity, an opportunity and a responsibility. There’s still plenty left to create.
And that’s exactly the good news

75d54206d037.text: What’s left to do? Learn, design, develop, deploy, try, and iterate again and again.
